description: This Java class, CustomerOptionsValueController, is a Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations for customer option values within an admin panel of an e-commerce application. It provides endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting customer option values, and handles localization through language support.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing customer option values, supporting list, create, edit, save, delete operations with localization and role-based authorization.

methods.name: displayOptionValues
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of customer option values.

methods.name: displayOptionValueEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the edit form for an existing customer option value.

methods.name: displayOptionValueCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the creation form for a new customer option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Internal method to prepare the customer option value form, whether for creating or editing.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a customer option value, with validation.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST request to return a paginated list of customer options in JSON format for AJAX.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a customer option value by ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu and navigation context in the model.
